title: Water filter
text: Water filter. Lovely color works fast and furious to filter water use multiple times a day.

product_metadata.title: Waterdrop 200-Gallon Long-Life Elfin 5-Cup Water Filter Pitcher with 1 Filter, NSF Certified, 5X Times Lifetime, Reduces Chlorine, BPA Free, Blue
features: [Modern design, multi-color options]: The modern, multi-color design of the water filter pitcher, coupled with a 5-cup filtration capacity and a compact body, is perfectly fit with your refrigerator, whether in the dormitory, home, or office. 💧3-pack replacement filters are available for purchase! (search model: WD-PF-01A Plus、WD-PF-01C Plus).

[NSF certified filtration performance]: This Waterdrop water pitcher has passed NSF42 and 372 certifications, confirming the use of high-quality activated carbon fiber only. The residual chlorine reduction rate is as high as 97.4%.

[5x longer lifespan]: The filter water pitcher has a filter lifespan of up to 200 gallons or 3 months, which is 5x that of competitor products. With the extended lifespan, you can purify your drinking water for a longer time. The flow rate is also 5x that of competitor products, ensuring the maximum filtration effect and faster delivery of clean drinking water.

[Gravity induction indicator]: The inbuilt indicator in the Waterdrop filter pitcher lets you know when it’s time to replace the filter. You can also check the filter status in real time while taking water from the system. ⚡This system DOES NOT lower TDS value. If you prefer low TDS value, please choose Waterdrop RO system.

[Exceptional quality]: The water filter pitcher is made of high-grade BPA-free plastic only. By means of an ergonomic handle, the filter pitcher is easier to hold. The coconut shell activated carbon and highly efficient activated carbon fiber from Japan in the Waterdrop filter pitcher guarantee optimal performance at all times. Waterdrop pitcher effectively reduces odor, iron, and metal ions like calcium, magnesium, mercury, copper, and other substances based on testing by a third-party laboratory, while improving the overall taste.

details.Included Components: Pitcher Filter Replacement *1, Water Filter Pitcher System *1, User's Manual *1
